concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs constitution.md:Data Hygiene / plan.md Constitution Check III
concerns.text: Constitution III and plan.md's Constitution Check row claim 'Raw files immutable under data/raw/; checksums recorded', but no task records dataset checksums under data/ (or in the state artifact_hashes map). T001 verifies NIfTI integrity (opens with nibabel, size > 0) but never computes/stores checksums. Add a checksum-recording step to T001 (or a new task) so this plan/constitution element has a covering task.

The constitution requires a version-pinned requirements.txt (or pyproject.toml) at code/ and plan.md's Constitution Check I cites 'requirements.txt version-locked', but no task creates or pins this file. T012 runs pytest but assumes dependencies exist. Add dependency-pinning to T001 (setup) or T012.
